title: WfGg Radar operational discovery and controlled runtime evolution
problem: Automate WfGg Radar cluster discovery end-to-end while preserving evidence quality, Last War read-only behavior, Collector integrity, and ChaCha DEV production governance.
goals: Run targeted @federated:<serverId> discovery cycles automatically until each cluster has three complete 9/9 evidence cycles.
Keep valid data from partial cycles while ensuring partial or joined cycles never count toward cluster confirmation.
After a cluster is confirmed, run Seed Scout automatically to discover the next observed seed and continue without manual browser actions.
Allow the browser/phone to disconnect or lock after Autopilot starts; execution remains server-side on the VPS.
Use ChaCha DEV Project Control, Scheduler, Run Controller and Radar Runtime Adapter for all runtime deployment changes.
Keep production changes bounded, approval-gated, reversible and independently observable.
non_goals: Do not change Last War game state or invoke mutating game commands.
Do not count partial 8/9 cycles, failed cycles, or joined cycles as cluster-confirmation evidence.
Do not persist the Last War token in jobs, Collector DB, logs, receipts, or filesystem.
Do not replace authoritative NAS persistence with VPS-local project storage.
Do not expose raw player data, credentials or runtime secrets.

current_change.purpose: Add a server-side Autopilot that chains complete targeted Collector cycles and Seed Scout discovery. It requires three fresh complete 9/9 cycles per seed, retries partial cycles without counting them, automatically discovers the next seed, and can continue while the browser is closed.

acceptance_criteria: V6.19.4 connector, Worker and UI build/tests pass on a pinned Git revision.
Pilot connector/native binaries and staged Cloudflare surfaces are SHA256 pinned before runtime installation.
Only SUCCESS non-joined cycles with 9/9 regions and zero isolated regions count toward the three-cycle confirmation target.
Partial cycles preserve valid Collector observations but retain a non-empty quality marker and never count as cluster confirmation.
Autopilot retries the same seed after partial cycles, stops on bounded failure/authentication guards, and supports stop-after-current-step.
After three complete cycles for a seed, Seed Scout runs automatically and the next observed seed becomes the next targeted scan.
Last War operations remain read-only; normal full discovery cycles intentionally update Collector evidence.
The Last War token remains ephemeral in memory and is never persisted by Autopilot.
The Autopilot runner does not require the phone/browser to remain open after start.
Production-deploy permission requires explicit human approval recorded in ChaCha DEV Evidence Ledger.
The guard-only PILOT executes no Last War scan and no Collector mutation; Radar Sentinel protection is restored and the approval is revoked after the pilot window.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
